title: Check the plan of a model before it runs
description: normalize_plan plus the checks of 13b ST11: a question with no sign of a comparison, a chain or two questions in one is a simple question and its only lookup is the question itself; in a compound plan, a lookup for the name of what the question already names, a lookup that shares fewer than two content words with the question, and near-duplicates are dropped; a multi-step plan that keeps under 60 percent of the content words is replaced by the question; a single lookup keeps the question's own words; a calculation is flagged by the wording as well. Answer: {subquestions, needs_calculation, single, checks, fallback}.
